issuer.description: The expected `iss` claim for `OIDC` providers, or the SPIFFE trust domain for `SPIFFE` providers.

audience.description: The value that the token's `aud` claim must contain.

jwks_url.description: The URL the signing keys are fetched from. For `OIDC` providers, this is the `jwks_uri` resolved from the issuer's discovery document. Absent when the keys were provided inline.

jwks_key_ids.description: The key IDs of the inline key set. Absent when the keys are fetched from a URL.

session_lifetime_seconds.description: The lifetime of sessions created through this provider, unless a binding sets its own.

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds since January 1, 1970 UTC.

workload-identity-provider-name.description: The name of the workload identity provider.

workload-identity-provider-type.description:
The type of issuer the provider trusts.

* `OIDC`: an OpenID Connect issuer. Tokens must carry an `iss` claim equal to the provider's issuer.
* `SPIFFE`: a SPIFFE trust domain. The `iss` claim is ignored, and `sub` must be a SPIFFE ID of that trust domain.
